rows.name:
Everyone, I heard you've been very
active since then, mo! Now you're
proper celebrities in this city, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000044_03_msg0002
rows.name:
But you're not the only ones getting
famous, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000044_03_msg0003
rows.name:
Lately Morimori has become famous not
just as a big eater, but as a gourmet
too, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000044_03_msg0004
rows.name:
Let us both become more famous
and liven up this city of Iira, mo!
